pythonRule.normalise: 27: NFKC, collapse Python whitespace runs to one space, strip.
pythonRule.regionText: 45: join retained lines in order after strict positive-area box intersections; unknown page=None.
pythonRule.boxesIntersect: 41: x0<x1 and y0<y1 on both boxes; touching edges do not intersect.
pythonRule.numberIsInQuote: 60: every NFKC Unicode decimal digit group in str(valueLiteral) must be a group in quote.
pythonRule.verifyItem: 67: source hash or quote failure first, then normalised region substring, then number groups.
